thread:
Elena Ruiz: opened a small PR to clarify the VPC egress proxy + KMS examples for private installs. Adds a lightweight nftables example, a checklist for checksum verification of offline bundles, and a "quick rollback" note for gateway IP flips. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5012

Samir Desai: thanks Elena. two asks from support: 1) include a one-line nftables rule that is safe to paste for testing, 2) show how to verify bundle checksum on macOS as well as Linux.

Elena Ruiz: added both. nftables one-liner: `nft add rule inet filter output tcp dport 4731 ip daddr 10.40.0.7 accept`

Elena Ruiz: macOS verify snippet (openssl): ```bash
# macOS: verify sha512
openssl dgst -sha512 -verify pubkey.pem -signature bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz
```

Olivia Park: add a short migration rollback step: if the new HSM gateway causes widespread TLS failures, revert the route and restart sidecars in waves. include a tiny checklist for rapid rollback.

Elena Ruiz: added rollback checklist: 1) revert route table to old gateway; 2) restore previous certs on sidecars (if rotated); 3) restart sidecars in 10% waves; 4) monitor for TLS handshakes to return to normal.

Samir Desai: please call out HSM port (4731) in the examples and warn about exposing it publicly. Also include conntrack tip: bump nf_conntrack_max and check nf_conntrack_count during cutover.

Elena Ruiz: done. sysctl example: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000` and diagnostic: `cat /proc/net/nf_conntrack | wc -l` (or `sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_count` depending on kernel).

Olivia Park: small nit: add a two-line Python SDK snippet showing base_url pointing at local sidecar for quick local validation (support often shares this).

Elena Ruiz: added Python snippet: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key='REDACTED', base_url='http://127.0.0.1:8080')
print(c.generate('ping').text)
```

docs-check-bot: ERROR: PR 5012 - broken internal link to /private/install/egress-proxy. Suggest /private/vpc/egress-proxy.

Elena Ruiz: thanks bot. updated links and added a short redirect note for customers with bookmarks. Grepped repo for occurrences and fixed a couple of internal anchors.

Samir Desai: one more: include a tiny tcpdump pattern to validate SNI when sidecar rewrites SNI (ops find this useful). Keep it simple.

Elena Ruiz: added tcpdump check: `tcpdump -i any -s0 -A 'tcp port 4731' | grep -i 'Server Name'` and a WARN: do not run tcpdump on production nodes without approval.

Olivia Park: LGTM from docs side after the link fix. I'll do a final phrasing pass tomorrow morning. Please include a short sentence reminding customers to update any hardcoded IPs in iptables after a gateway swap.

Elena Ruiz: added note about updating iptables/ipset entries that referenced the previous gateway IP. merging once CI passes. Will open a follow-up thread if support sees more migration fallout. :shipit:
